question: The Halda festival is celebrated in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__****Halda Festival:**

__
 
• One of the most significant festivals celebrated in **Himachal Pradesh's Lahaul **region is the **Halda Festival**, a sizable carnival held to welcome the **New Year.**
 
• The Halda Festival, one of Lahaul's most anticipated events, offers a **memorable experience** with its **exotic drinks, hypnotic dance performances, joyful family reunions, **and **vibrant cultural celebrations.**
 
• It is a **pleasant **and happy **event **when state people join together to celebrate the New Year and exchange prosperous wishes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Halda Festival honours the **Shiskar Apa,** the **Goddess **of **Wealth **in the Lamaistic Pantheon.
 
• The Halda Festival's centerpiece is a lovely **bonfire **that is lit in a spot decided upon by the **Lamas**.
 
• People congregate at this specified spot and light **cedar twigs **to make a massive **blaze**.
 
• The bonfire, which symbolises the oneness of the group, is a key component of the festivities in the valleys of the **Chandra **and **Bhaga Rivers **and **Keylong**.
 
• Festivities take place over the course of the **Halda Festival's two days**.
 
• This festival has an uncanny resemblance to Diwali, the **festival of lights.**
 
• It is observed on the fortunate day of **Magha Purnima.**
 
• The Halda Festival takes place in these isolated **Himalayan settings **and showcases the distinctive cultural mix of the **Lahaul, Keylong, Chandra, **and **Bhaga River Valleys.**
